senses.en: far along in age or at a late stage
senses.pattern: advanced age / advanced years / an advanced stage of cancer
senses.example: Despite her [[advanced]] age, my grandmother still walks to the market by herself every morning.
senses.example_zh: 儘管年邁，我的祖母仍然每天早上自己走路去市場。

senses.en: to understand fully how serious or important something is
senses.pattern: appreciate the difficulty / appreciate the importance of / fully appreciate that
senses.example: Few visitors [[appreciate]] how dangerous the mountain trail becomes after a heavy afternoon rain.
senses.example_zh: 很少遊客能體會午後大雨過後，這條山徑會變得多麼危險。
senses.note: 後面常接 that 子句或 wh- 子句

senses.en: to rise in value over time
senses.pattern: appreciate in value / appreciate by ten percent / appreciate against the dollar
senses.example: Experts expect the painting to [[appreciate]] in value as the artist becomes better known abroad.
senses.example_zh: 專家預期，隨著這位畫家在國外漸有名氣，這幅畫將會增值。

senses.en: to support someone or something, often with money
senses.pattern: back a plan / back a candidate / be backed by the government
senses.example: Several local companies agreed to [[back]] the students' plan to build a solar-powered boat.
senses.example_zh: 幾家當地公司同意資助學生打造太陽能船的計畫。

senses.en: to move or drive something backwards
senses.pattern: back the car into the garage / back away from / back out of the driveway
senses.example: The driver slowly [[backed]] the truck into the narrow alley while his partner gave hand signals.
senses.example_zh: 司機緩緩把卡車倒進窄巷，他的搭檔則在一旁打手勢。

senses.en: outside the limits, reach, or understanding of
senses.pattern: beyond repair / beyond belief / beyond one's control / beyond me
senses.example: Why anyone would pay that much for a pair of sneakers is completely [[beyond]] me.
senses.example_zh: 為什麼有人願意花那麼多錢買一雙球鞋，完全超出我的理解。

senses.en: apart from; other than
senses.pattern: nothing beyond / know little beyond / beyond that
senses.example: The witness could tell the police nothing [[beyond]] the color of the car that sped away.
senses.example_zh: 除了那輛疾駛而去的車子的顏色之外，目擊者無法告訴警方任何事。
senses.note: 多用於否定句或疑問句

gsat.sentence: This is because many breakthroughs come up when people venture [[beyond]] their usual routines or areas of expertise.
“The blessing that Morgan has brought is [[beyond]] anything that I ever could have imagined and could explain.”

senses.en: to give in to pressure or someone's demands
senses.pattern: bow to pressure / bow to public opinion / bow to demands / bow to the inevitable
senses.example: After weeks of protests from parents, the school finally [[bowed]] to pressure and dropped the new fee.
senses.example_zh: 在家長抗議數週後，學校終於向壓力屈服，取消了這項新收費。

senses.en: a knot with two loops, used as decoration
senses.pattern: tie a bow / tie a ribbon in a bow / a bow in her hair / a red bow
senses.example: She wrapped the gift in gold paper and tied the ribbon in a neat [[bow]] on top.
senses.example_zh: 她用金色的紙把禮物包好，並在上面用緞帶打了個整齊的蝴蝶結。

senses.en: the shape and size of a person's body
senses.pattern: a slim build / of medium build / a muscular build
senses.example: With his powerful [[build]] and quick feet, Jason was chosen as the team's goalkeeper in his first year.
senses.example_zh: 傑森體格壯碩、腳步又快，第一年就被選為球隊的守門員。
senses.note: 此義為名詞，通常用單數

senses.en: to grow gradually in strength or amount
senses.pattern: tension builds / pressure builds / build up over time
senses.example: Excitement [[built]] steadily among the fans as the final minutes of the game ticked away.
senses.example_zh: 隨著比賽最後幾分鐘一分一秒過去，球迷的興奮之情逐漸增強。

gsat.sentence: Pus will [[build]] up in the center of the stye, causing a yellowish spot.

senses.en: most important; having the main influence
senses.pattern: play a central role / be central to / a central theme / the central issue
senses.example: Trust between teachers and students is [[central]] to the success of any school program.
senses.example_zh: 師生之間的信任，是任何學校計畫能否成功的核心關鍵。

senses.en: to remove unwanted things from a place
senses.pattern: clear the table / clear snow from the road / clear A of B
senses.example: Volunteers spent the whole weekend [[clearing]] fallen branches from the hiking trail after the typhoon.
senses.example_zh: 颱風過後，志工花了整個週末清除登山步道上掉落的樹枝。

senses.en: to show officially that someone is not guilty
senses.pattern: be cleared of a crime / clear one's name / clear someone of all charges
senses.example: After a two-year investigation, the coach was finally [[cleared]] of cheating in the national tournament.
senses.example_zh: 經過兩年的調查，這位教練終於洗清了在全國錦標賽中作弊的嫌疑。

senses.en: to give or get official permission for something
senses.pattern: be cleared for takeoff / be cleared to land / clear customs
senses.example: The pilot waited on the runway for ten minutes before the plane was [[cleared]] for takeoff.
senses.example_zh: 飛行員在跑道上等了十分鐘，飛機才獲得批准起飛。

gsat.sentence: Moderate fires will [[clear]] the ground of competing plant life, and the rising heat dries and opens the ripe cones of the redwood, releasing many thousands of seeds onto the ground below.
To avoid this, scientists have devised several ways for [[clearing]] the sky.

senses.en: total; used to emphasize how great something is
senses.pattern: a complete stranger / a complete surprise / a complete disaster / a complete waste of time
senses.example: The school play was a [[complete]] disaster because half of the actors forgot their lines.
senses.example_zh: 這齣校園話劇是一場徹底的災難，因為半數演員都忘了台詞。
senses.note: 只放在名詞前，用來加強語氣

senses.en: to write the information needed on a form
senses.pattern: complete a form / complete a questionnaire / complete an application
senses.example: Please [[complete]] the application form in black ink and return it to the office by Friday.
senses.example_zh: 請用黑筆填寫申請表，並於週五前交回辦公室。

senses.en: to catch or develop an illness
senses.pattern: contract a disease / contract a virus / contract malaria
senses.example: Travelers to tropical regions may [[contract]] malaria if they are bitten by infected mosquitoes.
senses.example_zh: 前往熱帶地區的旅客若被帶原的蚊子叮咬，可能會感染瘧疾。

senses.en: to become smaller, shorter, or tighter
senses.pattern: muscles contract / metal contracts / the economy contracted
senses.example: Metal [[contracts]] as it cools, which is why bridges are built with small gaps between sections.
senses.example_zh: 金屬冷卻時會收縮，這就是橋梁各段之間留有小縫隙的原因。

gsat.sentence: Over 20% of people who [[contract]] it will suffer severe symptoms.
The increasing population in Texas raised the risk of [[contracting]] the disease.

senses.en: cells or bacteria grown for scientific study
senses.pattern: a cell culture / a culture of bacteria / tissue culture / grow in culture
senses.example: The researchers grew a [[culture]] of bacteria in the lab to test the new medicine.
senses.example_zh: 研究人員在實驗室裡做了細菌培養，用來測試這種新藥。
senses.note: 也可作動詞：培養（細菌、細胞）

senses.en: instructions for doing something or getting somewhere
senses.pattern: follow the directions / read the directions / ask for directions
senses.example: Read the [[directions]] on the bottle carefully before you give the medicine to a child.
senses.example_zh: 讓孩子服藥之前，請仔細閱讀瓶身上的使用說明。

senses.en: control or guidance of people or an activity
senses.pattern: under the direction of / under someone's direction / artistic direction
senses.example: Under the [[direction]] of Ms. Lin, the school choir won first prize in the national contest.
senses.example_zh: 在林老師的指導下，學校合唱團在全國比賽中奪得第一名。

gsat.sentence: They are often given a checklist that provides [[directions]] on what to observe or look out for to ensure consistency.
Sorry for being late. Someone gave me faulty [[directions]] and I got totally lost.

senses.en: to clean something by wiping dust off it
senses.pattern: dust the furniture / dust the shelves / dust off an old book
senses.example: Every Saturday morning, Tom helps his mother [[dust]] the bookshelves and mop the living room floor.
senses.example_zh: 每週六早上，湯姆都會幫媽媽拂去書架上的灰塵，並拖客廳的地板。
senses.note: dust off 也指「重新拿出來用」

senses.en: to cover something lightly with a fine powder
senses.pattern: dust A with B / dust the cake with sugar / lightly dusted with flour
senses.example: The baker [[dusted]] the warm cake with powdered sugar before placing it in the shop window.
senses.example_zh: 麵包師傅把糖粉撒在溫熱的蛋糕上，然後把蛋糕放進櫥窗。

gsat.sentence: One day, she [[dusted]] off the story she had written for the writers’ group and decided to make it into a novel.

senses.en: flat and smooth; steady and regular
senses.pattern: an even surface / even ground / at an even pace
senses.example: Make sure the floor is [[even]] before you lay the tiles, or they may crack later.
senses.example_zh: 鋪磁磚之前要確認地面是平坦的，否則磁磚日後可能會裂開。

senses.en: equal in amount, level, or strength
senses.pattern: an even contest / an even distribution / an even chance
senses.example: It was such an [[even]] contest that nobody could predict the winner until the final minute.
senses.example_zh: 這場比賽雙方勢均力敵，直到最後一分鐘都沒人能預測誰會贏。

senses.en: to make or become equal or level
senses.pattern: even out / even the score / even things up
senses.example: A late goal [[evened]] the score, and the crowd jumped to their feet in excitement.
senses.example_zh: 比賽尾聲的一記進球把比數拉平，觀眾興奮得跳了起來。

gsat.sentence: To [[even]] things out, the body will get rid of water by producing urine.

senses.en: to succeed or get along in a stated way
senses.pattern: fare well / fare badly / fare better than
senses.example: Students who review their notes every day usually [[fare]] better on exams than those who cram.
senses.example_zh: 每天複習筆記的學生，考試表現通常比臨時抱佛腳的人好。

senses.en: the kind of food served at a place
senses.pattern: traditional fare / simple fare / local fare / vegetarian fare
senses.example: The night market is famous for its traditional [[fare]], such as oyster omelets and stinky tofu.
senses.example_zh: 這個夜市以蚵仔煎、臭豆腐等傳統食物聞名。

gsat.sentence: Initially Velcro did not [[fare]] well.

senses.en: to go or gather somewhere in large numbers
senses.pattern: flock to the beach / flock to see / flock together
senses.example: Shoppers [[flocked]] to the department store on the first day of its anniversary sale.
senses.example_zh: 週年慶第一天，購物人潮蜂擁到這家百貨公司。

gsat.sentence: In fact, a visit to a major European city just would not be the same without encountering them: bathing in fountains, perching on historic buildings, and [[flocking]] in public squares.
Meanwhile, fans across the U.S. are [[flocking]] to sports shows to have their heroes sign anything from a bat to a box of cereal.

senses.en: to help something progress or succeed
senses.pattern: further one's career / further the cause of / further one's interests
senses.example: The scholarship was created to [[further]] the study of marine life in the Pacific region.
senses.example_zh: 這項獎學金的設立，是為了促進太平洋地區海洋生物的研究。
senses.note: 此義為及物動詞，後面直接接受詞

senses.en: great in amount, degree, or seriousness
senses.pattern: heavy losses / a heavy fine / pay a heavy price
senses.example: The typhoon caused [[heavy]] losses to banana farmers in the southern part of the island.
senses.example_zh: 颱風使島嶼南部的蕉農蒙受嚴重的損失。

senses.en: doing a particular thing a lot or too much
senses.pattern: a heavy smoker / a heavy drinker / a heavy sleeper / a heavy user
senses.example: As a [[heavy]] user of social media, Amy checks her phone more than a hundred times a day.
senses.example_zh: 身為社群媒體的重度使用者，艾咪一天查看手機超過一百次。
senses.note: a heavy meal＝油膩難消化的一餐

gsat.sentence: The [[heaviest]] drinkers in medieval Europe were actually Germans.

senses.en: the quality of working hard
senses.pattern: a person of great industry / reward someone's industry / industry and thrift
senses.example: The teacher praised Kevin for his [[industry]], noting that he never missed a single assignment.
senses.example_zh: 老師稱讚凱文的勤奮，並提到他從未漏交任何一份作業。

senses.en: affecting only one part of the body
senses.pattern: a local anesthetic / under local anesthesia / a local infection
senses.example: The dentist gave Ben a [[local]] anesthetic, so he stayed awake but felt no pain.
senses.example_zh: 牙醫為班施打局部麻醉，所以他保持清醒卻不覺得痛。

senses.en: a person who lives in a particular area
senses.pattern: ask the locals / popular with locals / locals and tourists
senses.example: If you want to find the best noodle shop in town, just ask the [[locals]].
senses.example_zh: 如果你想找鎮上最好吃的麵店，問當地人就對了。

senses.en: a way of doing or achieving something
senses.pattern: a means of transportation / by means of / a means to an end
senses.example: For people living on the small island, the ferry is the only [[means]] of reaching the mainland.
senses.example_zh: 對住在這座小島上的人來說，渡輪是前往本島的唯一方法。

senses.en: the money or income that a person has
senses.pattern: live within one's means / beyond one's means / a person of means
senses.example: Hiring a private tutor was beyond the family's [[means]], so Kelly studied with free online videos instead.
senses.example_zh: 請家教超出這家人的財力，所以凱莉改看免費的線上影片自學。

gsat.sentence: Keep in mind that even short periods of low-impact exercise serve as a powerful [[means]] to improve your health.
However, drinking tea in social settings outside the workplace was beyond the [[means]] of the majority of British people.

senses.en: something that you must have, see, or do
senses.pattern: a must for / an absolute must / a must-see
senses.example: Comfortable shoes are a [[must]] if you plan to walk around the old town all day.
senses.example_zh: 如果你打算整天在老城區走動，一雙舒適的鞋子是必備之物。

senses.en: to keep someone busy or fill their mind
senses.pattern: occupy oneself with / be occupied with / keep someone occupied
senses.example: During the long flight, the children [[occupied]] themselves with puzzles and picture books.
senses.example_zh: 在漫長的航程中，孩子們忙於玩拼圖和看繪本。

senses.en: to hold a job, position, or rank
senses.pattern: occupy a position / occupy a post / occupy first place
senses.example: Ms. Wu [[occupied]] the post of school principal for twelve years before she retired last June.
senses.example_zh: 吳女士擔任校長一職十二年，直到去年六月才退休。

gsat.sentence: Although Russia does not [[occupy]] first place when it comes to alcohol consumption per capita, it is still close to the top.

senses.en: a group of hunting animals or of similar people
senses.pattern: a pack of wolves / a pack of dogs / hunt in packs / the leader of the pack
senses.example: A [[pack]] of wolves was seen crossing the frozen lake early yesterday morning.
senses.example_zh: 昨天清晨有人看見一群狼越過結冰的湖面。

senses.en: to fill a place completely with people or things
senses.pattern: pack the stadium / pack the streets / be packed with
senses.example: More than fifty thousand fans [[packed]] the stadium to watch the final game of the season.
senses.example_zh: 超過五萬名球迷擠滿了體育場，觀看本季最後一場比賽。

gsat.sentence: As the children grow, they run around the village in a [[pack]], wearing identical clothing and hairstyles, staring at everyone impolitely.

senses.en: favorite; especially liked or cared about
senses.pattern: a pet project / a pet subject / a pet theory / a pet peeve
senses.example: Building a small library for the village children has long been the mayor's [[pet]] project.
senses.example_zh: 為村裡的孩子蓋一座小圖書館，一直是鎮長最熱衷的計畫。

senses.en: to touch an animal gently with your hand
senses.pattern: pet a dog / pet the cat / pet an animal gently
senses.example: The little girl gently [[petted]] the rabbit until it fell asleep in her arms.
senses.example_zh: 小女孩輕輕撫摸著兔子，直到牠在她懷裡睡著。

senses.en: all the animals or plants of one kind in an area
senses.pattern: the fish population / a wild population / a population of sea turtles
senses.example: The island's seabird [[population]] has doubled since rats were removed ten years ago.
senses.example_zh: 自從十年前清除老鼠以來，島上的海鳥族群數量已增加一倍。

gsat.sentence: In the Indian state of Assam, growing numbers of tea farms are destroying the Asian elephant’s habitats and endangering their [[population]].
The city council originally proposed reducing the pigeon [[population]] by gathering the birds and shooting them.

senses.en: fresh fruit and vegetables grown on farms
senses.pattern: fresh produce / local produce / organic produce / farm produce
senses.example: The restaurant buys all its [[produce]] from small farms within thirty kilometers of the city.
senses.example_zh: 這家餐廳所有的農產品都購自城市方圓三十公里內的小農場。
senses.note: 名詞重音在第一音節，不可數

senses.en: to show or bring out something for others to see
senses.pattern: produce a ticket / produce one's passport / produce evidence
senses.example: The guard refused to let us in until we [[produced]] our student ID cards.
senses.example_zh: 警衛直到我們出示學生證，才肯讓我們進去。

gsat.sentence: The local farmers’ market is popular as it offers a variety of fresh seasonal [[produce]] to people in the community.

senses.en: a line of mountains or hills
senses.pattern: a mountain range / a range of hills / a coastal range
senses.example: A snow-covered [[range]] of mountains separates the dry desert from the green coastal plain.
senses.example_zh: 一條白雪覆蓋的山脈，把乾燥的沙漠和翠綠的沿海平原隔開。

senses.en: to vary between two stated limits
senses.pattern: range from A to B / range between A and B / range in age from
senses.example: Ticket prices for the concert [[range]] from eight hundred to five thousand dollars.
senses.example_zh: 這場演唱會的票價從八百元到五千元不等。

gsat.sentence: These methods [[range]] from a simple step like makeup to a drastic one like surgery.
But some mountain [[ranges]] of South America, Africa, and Indonesia are also home to glaciers and ice sheets.

senses.en: to go somewhere and say that you have arrived
senses.pattern: report to the office / report for duty / report for work
senses.example: All new students must [[report]] to the main office by eight o'clock on the first day.
senses.example_zh: 所有新生必須在開學第一天八點前到總辦公室報到。

senses.en: to tell the authorities about a crime or wrongdoing
senses.pattern: report a crime / report a theft / report someone to the police
senses.example: A neighbor [[reported]] the noisy factory to the city government after weeks of sleepless nights.
senses.example_zh: 連續幾週夜不成眠之後，一位鄰居向市政府檢舉了這家吵鬧的工廠。

senses.en: to make an official decision, especially in court
senses.pattern: rule that / rule in favor of / rule against / rule on a case
senses.example: The judge [[ruled]] that the factory must pay for cleaning up the polluted river.
senses.example_zh: 法官裁定該工廠必須支付清理受污染河川的費用。

senses.en: to decide that something is not possible
senses.pattern: rule out the possibility / rule out a cause / cannot be ruled out
senses.example: Police have not [[ruled]] out the possibility that the fire was started on purpose.
senses.example_zh: 警方尚未排除有人蓄意縱火的可能性。

gsat.sentence: If a serious injury is [[ruled]] out and the pain is not getting worse after exercising, then the exercise “makes a lot of sense.”

senses.en: the beginning or cause of a feeling or development
senses.pattern: the seeds of doubt / sow the seeds of / plant the seeds of
senses.example: The unfair decision sowed the [[seeds]] of distrust between the two neighboring villages.
senses.example_zh: 這項不公平的決定，成了兩個相鄰村莊互不信任的根源。

senses.en: a ranked player or team in a competition
senses.pattern: the top seed / the number one seed / the third seed
senses.example: The young player surprised everyone by beating the top [[seed]] in the first round.
senses.example_zh: 這名年輕選手在第一輪就擊敗頭號種子選手，令所有人大感意外。

senses.en: feeling that you want to vomit
senses.pattern: feel sick / be sick to one's stomach / make someone sick
senses.example: The winding mountain road made several passengers feel [[sick]], so the driver stopped for a break.
senses.example_zh: 蜿蜒的山路讓好幾位乘客覺得想吐，司機於是停車休息。
senses.note: 英式 be sick 也指「嘔吐」

senses.en: tired of or annoyed by something
senses.pattern: be sick of / be sick and tired of / get sick of
senses.example: I am [[sick]] of hearing the same excuses every time you hand in your homework late.
senses.example_zh: 每次你遲交作業都是同一套藉口，我已經厭倦了。

gsat.sentence: Your brain’s confused reaction makes you feel [[sick]].
If you have ever been [[sick]] to your stomach on a rocking boat or a bumpy car ride, you know the discomfort of motion sickness.

senses.en: an organization of people with a shared interest
senses.pattern: a drama society / a historical society / join a society
senses.example: Lily joined the school's photography [[society]] to learn how to take better pictures of birds.
senses.example_zh: 莉莉加入學校的攝影社團，想學習如何把鳥拍得更好。

gsat.sentence: Last week Jay McCarroll and The HSUS (The Humane [[Society]] of the United States) made a bold fur-free statement on the runway, marking <u>a new chapter</u> for the fashion industry and animal protection.

senses.en: used with units to measure area
senses.pattern: square meters / square kilometers / per square inch
senses.example: The new city park covers nearly two [[square]] kilometers and includes a lake and a forest.
senses.example_zh: 這座新的市立公園佔地將近兩平方公里，內有一座湖和一片森林。
senses.note: 名詞亦指「平方」：the square of 3 is 9

senses.en: to agree or be consistent with something
senses.pattern: square with the facts / square with the evidence / square with one's beliefs
senses.example: The driver's story did not [[square]] with what the traffic camera had recorded.
senses.example_zh: 駕駛的說法與交通監視器錄到的畫面不相符。

gsat.sentence: By 1955, he had completed an improved version of the product, with each [[square]] inch of material containing 300 hooks, which made it stay fastened and yet easy enough to pull apart when needed.
The ice sheets, which once spanned 20 [[square]] kilometers, are thinning over five times as quickly compared to a few years ago.

senses.en: a good quality or ability that someone has
senses.pattern: strengths and weaknesses / one's greatest strength / play to one's strengths
senses.example: One of Jenny's greatest [[strengths]] as a team leader is her ability to listen patiently.
senses.example_zh: 珍妮身為組長最大的優點之一，就是能耐心傾聽。

gsat.sentence: Different dogs display [[strengths]] in different intelligences.
The moral lesson is “First identify your [[strengths]], and then change the playing field to suit them.”

senses.en: to live longer than someone
senses.pattern: survive one's husband / survive someone by ten years / be survived by
senses.example: Mrs. Baker [[survived]] her husband by twelve years and spent them traveling around the world.
senses.example_zh: 貝克太太比丈夫多活了十二年，並用這些歲月環遊世界。
senses.note: be survived by＝身後留下（家屬）

senses.en: to give or hold a party
senses.pattern: throw a party / throw a birthday party / throw a farewell party
senses.example: The class decided to [[throw]] a farewell party for the exchange student from Germany.
senses.example_zh: 全班決定為來自德國的交換學生舉辦一場歡送派對。

senses.en: to confuse or upset someone suddenly
senses.pattern: be thrown by a question / throw someone off / throw someone off balance
senses.example: The unexpected question about her family completely [[threw]] the speaker, and she fell silent.
senses.example_zh: 那個關於她家人的意外提問讓講者頓時慌亂，一時說不出話來。

senses.en: a clever and effective way of doing something
senses.pattern: the trick is to / a trick for remembering / do the trick
senses.example: The [[trick]] to making fluffy pancakes is to avoid stirring the batter too much.
senses.example_zh: 煎出鬆軟鬆餅的訣竅，就是不要過度攪拌麵糊。

senses.en: to make someone believe something false
senses.pattern: trick someone into doing / trick someone out of money / be tricked by
senses.example: The website [[tricked]] thousands of users into giving away their passwords and bank details.
senses.example_zh: 這個網站欺騙了數千名使用者，讓他們交出密碼和銀行資料。

gsat.sentence: Especially when a burger craving hits…a GreenBurger does the [[trick]].
Their brain is therefore [[tricked]] into thinking they are eating more than they really are.

senses.en: to begin and continue a war or campaign
senses.pattern: wage war on / wage a campaign against / wage a battle
senses.example: The city government is [[waging]] a campaign against littering in parks and on beaches.
senses.example_zh: 市政府正發動一場運動，打擊在公園和海灘亂丟垃圾的行為。

senses.en: something that causes great admiration or surprise
senses.pattern: a natural wonder / the wonders of nature / the Seven Wonders of the World
senses.example: The Grand Canyon is one of the natural [[wonders]] that attract millions of visitors every year.
senses.example_zh: 大峽谷是每年吸引數百萬遊客的自然奇觀之一。

senses.en: a feeling of surprise and admiration
senses.pattern: in wonder / a sense of wonder / be filled with wonder
senses.example: The children stared in [[wonder]] as the magician pulled a live rabbit out of an empty hat.
senses.example_zh: 魔術師從空帽子裡拉出一隻活兔子時，孩子們驚奇地睜大眼睛看著。

gsat.sentence: This common device is a [[wonder]] of simplicity and function.

quiz.stem: After swimming in the polluted lake during the camping trip, three students ______ a serious skin infection and needed medical treatment.
quiz.explain_zh: contract＝感染（疾病）。三名學生在受污染的湖裡游泳後染上嚴重的皮膚感染。

quiz.stem: Witnesses described the thief as a young man of medium ______ with short black hair, wearing a blue cap and carrying a sports bag.
quiz.explain_zh: build＝體格、身材。目擊者形容小偷是中等身材、黑色短髮的年輕男子。

quiz.stem: Because of the patient's ______ age and weak heart, the doctors decided that an operation would be too risky.
quiz.explain_zh: advanced＝年邁的。病人年事已高、心臟又弱，醫生認為開刀太冒險。

quiz.stem: Every winter, thousands of bird lovers ______ to the wetland to catch a glimpse of rare birds arriving from the north.
quiz.explain_zh: flock＝蜂擁、聚集。每年冬天，成千上萬的愛鳥人士湧向濕地觀賞稀有候鳥。

quiz.stem: With prices rising every month, many families find it harder to live within their ______ and have to borrow money.
quiz.explain_zh: means＝財力、收入。物價月月上漲，許多家庭難以量入為出，只好借錢。

quiz.stem: The final math problem was completely ______ most of the class; even the top student had no idea where to begin.
quiz.explain_zh: beyond＝超出（能力、理解）。最後一題數學連全班第一名都不知從何下手。

quiz.stem: For decades, the island's farmers have been ______ a battle against wild pigs that dig up their sweet potato fields at night.
quiz.explain_zh: wage＝進行（戰爭、戰鬥）。島上農民數十年來一直與夜裡破壞地瓜田的野豬作戰。

quiz.stem: Thanks to the new high-speed rail station, land in this once-quiet town has ______ sharply, with prices doubling in just five years.
quiz.explain_zh: appreciate＝增值。高鐵站設立後，小鎮的土地五年內價格翻倍。

quiz.stem: Mr. Chang started as a factory cleaner, but through thirty years of ______ and careful saving, he eventually owned three restaurants.
quiz.explain_zh: industry＝勤勉。張先生靠三十年的勤奮與儲蓄，從清潔工變成三家餐廳的老闆。

quiz.stem: Hikers should set up their tents on ______ ground, because sleeping on a slope or on rocks can be very uncomfortable.
quiz.explain_zh: even＝平坦的。帳篷應搭在平坦的地面上，睡在斜坡或石頭上會很不舒服。
